requirements.title: DATA and declaration initialization make variables initially defined
requirements.definition: Variables specified to have initial values by DATA statements or type declaration statements are initially defined.

pending.data-statement-initially-defined: Declare integer x with DATA x /314/, initialize result sentinel to -777 at program start, assign sentinel=x, and assert 314 before any executable definition of x.
pending.declaration-initializer-initially-define: Declare integer :: y=-271, copy y to a result sentinel initialized to -777 at the first executable statement, and assert -271.

requirements.title: Saved default-initialized subcomponents are initially defined
requirements.definition: Nonpointer default-initialized subcomponents of saved variables lacking ALLOCATABLE or POINTER are initially defined.

pending.saved-default-initialized-subcomponent-i: Define type t with integer component initialized to 55, declare SAVE :: obj of type t, copy obj%component to sentinel -777 at first execution, and assert 55.

requirements.title: Initially associated pointers to initially defined variables are initially defined
requirements.source: S19.6.3 p1.initially-associated-pointers, J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF562.
requirements.definition: Pointers specified to be initially associated with a variable that is initially defined are initially defined.

pending.initially-associated-pointer-to-defined-: Declare TARGET integer saved with initializer 91 and pointer initialized to that target, copy pointer value to sentinel -777 at first execution, and assert 91.

requirements.title: Always-defined variables and externally initialized BIND variables are initially defined
requirements.definition: Variables that are always defined are initially defined, and BIND variables initialized by means other than Fortran are initially defined.

pending.always-defined-variable-initially-define: Use character(len=0) s at program start, copy LEN(s) to sentinel -777, and assert 0 as the initially defined always-defined variable case.
pending.bind-variable-initialized-by-companion-i: Build mixed Fortran/C: C defines int blivet=123; Fortran declares integer(C_INT), bind(C,name="blivet") :: foo, copies foo to sentinel -777 at first execution, and asserts 123.
